result.title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs: When a Small Model Is Enough
result.summary: In procedural tool-use domains, how much of the gap between base models is procedure rather than capability? We build an explicit program from a teacher's traces and run it in front of unchanged small models, including an 8B model. The construction, PLVR , takes the reasoning traces of a teacher, Kimi-K3, clusters their segments to locate recurring operations, has a frontier model author one typed primitive per operation, each run by a small frozen model and assembles the program by A* search over a mined rule library, under a reference-action objective. At inference the program takes one of two forms: for troubleshooting and tool search it produces the chain of thought the student would otherwise generate for itself, and the student acts on it; for multi-turn tool matching the student proposes each action and the program checks, repairs, or retries it before it goes out. On the official tau2-Bench Retail and Telecom test sets and on LiveMCPBench, with three Nemotron base models and the same program for each, the answer depends on the domain. On Telecom, Granite-4.2-8B as the student goes from 43.0% to 91.2% under the program, and every Nemotron student reaches 93.3-94.4%, against at most 58.2% for fine-tuning on the same traces, prompt optimisation of the student, or two token-matched baselines. With Granite-4.2-8B as the student, the program is within 2 to 3 points of the Nemotron students on Telecom and within 3 on Retail, and 3 to 13 points below them on LiveMCPBench: where the domain is procedural an 8B student is enough, and on tool search the student still matters. On Retail and LiveMCPBench the program is competitive with the best baseline. The spread between base models shrinks from about 7 points to about 2, averaged over the suites, with no weights changed.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把教师模型（Kimi-K3）的推理轨迹编译成显式类型化程序 PLVR：聚类轨迹片段定位重复操作，由前沿模型为每个操作编写原语，再用 A* 搜索在规则库上组装程序；推理时程序或生成学生本应自产的思维链、或对学生提出的动作做检查、修复与重试，在 tau2-Bench Retail/Telecom 与 LiveMCPBench 上用未改权重的 8B 等小模型验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在冻结小模型之外用程序检查/修复/重试候选动作并生成推理链」的机制，与 LVR 中推理状态的外部校验、贡献定位及停止/重试决策可能存在方法联系，可供核查；材料无视觉或多模态内容，故不按主线入选。
